name: libretranslate
title: LibreTranslate
description: LibreTranslate is a translation API and web page that runs entirely on your server (Argos models, no Google). Pick the languages to load — every one adds a model download on first start (models live in a Docker volume); Nextcloud, Immich and many apps can use it as their translation backend.

variables.name: LIBRETRANSLATE_LANGUAGES
variables.label: Languages to load
variables.description: Comma-separated ISO codes; fewer languages = faster start and less RAM
